Both tasks re-plan the two last-batch blocked tasks (selected-cell-legibility, gesture-guards-and-pending-layer) with different approaches named in their judgment_basis; all edits stay under web/ and no repo-root document may be modified.
escalations: NEAR drawing-session experiment (board-review step 4) stays ask-first: authorizing a function-call key limited to the board's draw method with a bounded gas allowance, plain-language activation / remaining allowance / renewal / revoke, and verified on-chain key removal. This touches wallet signing, key creation and a testnet deployment, so a human decision on allowance scope plus a funded testnet account and game contract identifier is needed before a brief can be written.

The milestone's live two-session check ('two people on separate devices observe each other's work automatically') still needs a deployed testnet board contract and a configured VITE_CONTRACT_ID; that is a human deployment step. Without it only mock/local verification is possible, so confirmed changes visible within ~3-5 seconds cannot be demonstrated from agent work alone.

Saturated palette proposal (docs/2026-10-12-palette-proposal.md) remains ask-first: moving past the eight-color contract palette changes metadata coordinated across web/shared/contract and the meaning of already-stored colors. Per the judgment doc ('ask first: ... economy changes', contract changes) it needs a tier-2 decision-record update in docs/00-shared-decisions.md before any implementation task is written.
